comment: Retrieval eval set. `expect_any` holds canonical book ids from app/services/shelf.py — NEVER source_path substrings. The old set matched filenames and silently measured spelling instead of retrieval: `mcgee` matched 0 indexed files (On Food and Cooking is filed under its title), `food-lab` matched 0, and `gf` matched 25 because a release group is called DawgFather. A question whose expected books are all unindexed is reported ABSENT and excluded from the hit rate — it is a gap in the shelf, not a retrieval failure. Grow this set with api/scripts/harvest_questions.py; a human commits the expectations.
